citations.title: Iberdrola secures 98% support at AGM and re-elects Pedro Azagra as CEO

sentences.text: Azagra, a 25-year Iberdrola veteran, was appointed group CEO in June 2025, moving up from running US subsidiary Avangrid, and works alongside executive chairman Ignacio Galan.
On execution, 2025 net profit rose 12% to EUR 6,285m, with networks EBITDA up 21% offsetting a 10% decline in power and customers.

sentences.quote: the company reiterated its EUR 43 billion investment plan for the period 2026-2028
sentences.text: Capital allocation tilts to regulated assets: the 2025-2028 plan commits EUR 58bn, with 85% going to A-rated countries and two-thirds to networks; net debt fell EUR 1.5bn and the dividend rose 6.3%.

sentences.quote: Iberdrola's shareholders have approved all items put to the vote at the Annual General Meeting held this Friday, with an average approval rate of 98%
sentences.text: Shareholders approved all AGM items with 98% average support, including Azagra's reappointment.
